fusions.name: Long Day's Ride
fusions.desc: Rides down a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 38 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.5 times the damage from the full 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Trot Drum
fusions.desc: Drums the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Last Furlong
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you recover 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
